why: LITERAL-GROUND (2026-10-11). Sentence embeddings cannot separate a preposition's functional use from its rare senses. Primary leaves are declared here because SpanishDict's page order puts 'de' = 'from' first.

entries.primary_gloss: of the | used to indicate relationship or possession

not_guarded.por: for / by / through / per are all common; a declared primary would overwrite real uses
not_guarded.para: 'to' is as common as 'for'; a 'for' primary turned 'mudei para Boston' into 'for' on the pt sample
not_guarded.a: its verb-object use is the personal 'a' (odio a la gente), a SpanishDict sense of its own; a 'direction' prior overwrote it on 9 of 30 sample rows
not_guarded.al: frequency / position / direction split evenly; 'al mando' became 'to the' under a direction prior
not_guarded.en: time and mode are real uses ('en junio', 'en francés'); a 'place' prior overwrote them on 8 of 30 sample rows

active_card_threshold: not here: the app moves a sense under 10% of a card's sentences to Rarer uses (MAIN_CARD_MIN_SHARE, app/js/vocab.js), pooled by translation for prepositions
